title: Dev-dep risk: wiremock 0.6.5 is stable but 2+ years old; no urgent updates visible
description:
wiremock 0.6 was released 2022, last update Feb 2024. The crate is low-complexity (HTTP mock server builder). Breaking changes are rare.

ANALYSIS: wiremock 0.6 only appears in [dev-dependencies]. It mocks /jmap/api and /.well-known/jmap. Tests pass cleanly (15 passing, 0 failing).

MAINTENANCE RISK: Low. The API surface tested is stable (Mock, MockServer, ResponseTemplate with .set_body_json). wiremock is a widely-used testing tool in Rust HTTP crates; if critical bugs arise, the community will alert.

RECOMMENDATION: No action needed for Phase 1. If wiremock becomes unmaintained, porting tests to a newer fork (e.g., httpmock, mockito) is trivial (< 2 hours). Upgrade only if a security issue is found.
